label: Industriens Pension
field.name: Name
help.capital: Enter the statement capital for the pension components you are modeling.
help.pay: Enter the pay on which the agreement contribution is calculated. Leave at zero to forecast from statement capital alone.
help.contributionStart: Use the date your employer confirms, including any qualifying seniority.
help.deductions: Enter the monthly difference between the gross contribution and the credit to the modeled savings.
help.rateQuote: Enter the insurer’s amount before tax for the selected payout period.
help.lifelongQuote: Enter the insurer’s amount before tax for the selected start.
help.eligibility: Use the earliest date shown by Industriens Pension for the quoted benefits.
help.start: Choose when payments begin and contributions are expected to stop.
invalid.person: Select an individual with a birth month and year.
invalid.contribution: Enter the eligible contribution date and monthly deductions.
invalid.payout: Enter the earliest eligible date and a payout start at or after it.
invalid.rateWindow: Ratepension must end within 30 years of the earliest eligible payout date.
